notes.note: Reviewed the proposed isolation boundary against the telemetry persistence callback, late product-service construction and exact destination grants. StationRuntime still owns one home and application runtime; telemetry credentials do not create tenant, Project or arbitrary-code confinement. The new constructor captures current saved configuration before sender construction without changing plugin placement or hosted storage admission. Preserve proposed status, unsupported hosted transports and required two-tenant/termination experiments. No prose change; source review only, no sandbox, hosted runtime or recovery qualification.

Traced the personal-host mount, Project authorizer and browser service composition against the telemetry route callback. Browser access still requires its existing operator/admin standing and bound Session; telemetry destination grants and status reads confer no browser profile, navigation, evaluation or control lease. The new late product-service initialization does not change Chromium ownership, egress rules, acquisition consent or session lifetime. Preserve per-OS and application-specific qualification limits. No prose change; no browser or runtime execution.

Reviewed the full current device guide and actual personal-host/device-access composition. Exact telemetry transport/destination authority cannot authorize device shares, capture, drive, helper installation or physical application access. The new saved telemetry callback changes neither the captured device-helper endpoint nor its documented restart requirement; collector restart fencing is a separate owner. Live input acceptance, video liveness and app/build provenance remain distinct. No prose change; no helper, simulator, remote host, physical device or native qualification.

Reviewed paired-device, remote execution, read-only home visibility and fleet inference distinctions against config PUT authority and telemetry persistence. access:manage may configure a destination, but does not by itself mint the exact instance-owned secret grant; neither credential supplies orchestration, inference or home-transfer authority. The callback applies only the validated persisted telemetry configuration before unrelated Agent activation, preserving contribution/full-access controls and remote execution ownership. No prose change; no pairing, SSH, delegation, revocation or provider execution.

Reviewed the proposal/current-status header and existing authority-bearing route composition against telemetry configuration changes. Config destination mutation rejects Agent callers and retains operator/access:manage admission; exact secret destination grants remain separately authorized. Persisted emitter fencing adds no passkey sign-in, per-action step-up, device-admin write or remote operator session. Dated line citations and unresolved decisions remain historical/proposed, not current implemented coverage. No prose change; no passkey, paired-browser or operator runtime experiment.

Reviewed the complete supported Agent identity inventory and module-map delta. The map adds narrow instance telemetry secret grants, child materialization and emitter fencing, without manufacturing Agent IDs, aliases, engine identities or a schema migration. Late telemetry construction uses ConfigLoader current configuration and preserves the Agent registry/default-Agent publication path. Existing removal inventory and negative identity exemptions retain their scope. No prose change; no identity inventory scan, schema-home experiment or native onboarding execution.
